info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Customer Position Information API
info.description: The Customer Position Information API provides access to detailed insights regarding a customer's financial standing within their banking accounts. By leveraging this endpoint, users can retrieve current data on account balances, transactions, and overall customer positions. This API is particularly useful for banking applications, financial analysts, and customer service representatives looking to support clients with their account inquiries. Typical consumers include financial institutions and fintech platforms aiming to enhance their customer management capabilities.

get.description: Fetches detailed information regarding the specified customer position, identified by its unique ID. This endpoint is essential for accessing customer-specific data and understanding their financial standing.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve the customer position details for a specific customer identified by CUST-100045. Ensure that the request is properly formatted to receive the expected information.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the customer position details.

GetCustomerPositionByIdRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for fetching the operations related to a specific customer position. It is expected to be a string that contains the necessary identifiers or data.

accountId.description: The unique identifier for the account.

customerId.description: The unique identifier for the customer.

ledgerDate.description: The date of the ledger entry.

currency.description: The currency associated with the ledger balance.

ledgerBalance.description: The current balance in the ledger.

version.description: The version number of the record.

updatedAt.description: The date and time when the record was last updated.

metadata.description: Additional metadata related to the response.

GetCustomerPositionByIdResponse_200.description: Schema representing the response for the operations on customer positions.

responseId.description: A unique identifier for the response.

correlationId.description: A unique identifier to correlate requests and responses.

generatedAt.description: Timestamp when the response was generated.

processingRegion.description: The region where the response was processed.

bearerAuth.description: This security scheme uses the Bearer authentication method, whereby a JSON Web Token (JWT) is provided in the request header to authenticate the user or application. It allows for secure, stateless communication between the client and server.
